name: photorealistic-blue-pigtail-maid
image_vibe: Detailed blue-accented maid couture with shy charm and clean studio polish
image_purpose: Create a character-fashion studio portrait for editorial lookbook and visual development use.

prompt.project_info: A highly detailed photorealistic studio portrait of an original adult woman styled in elaborate black, white, and blue maid fashion.
prompt.main_subject: An original adult woman with long hair in high twin pigtails, blue gradient tips, and two thick braids. She wears a frilly white-and-dark-blue maid headdress and an elaborate black-and-white maid outfit with an oversized ruffled collar, puff sleeves, corset-style bodice, and a short layered skirt with multiple frills and bows. Give her fair natural skin, visible realistic pores, soft blush, bright expressive eyes, and a slightly shy expression.
prompt.composition_elements: Centered standing portrait against a pure white seamless background, with the headdress, twin pigtails, ruffles, lace, bows, corset structure, and hair strands clearly visible.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft diffused front studio lighting with gentle shadow control, clean white environment, delicate fashion-catalog atmosphere, and restrained blue accents against black and white styling.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic editorial portrait, 85mm lens, f/4, high-resolution detail, natural skin tone variation and visible pores, intricate lace and fabric texture, realistic individual hair strands, subtle optical falloff, no text or watermark.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a highly detailed photorealistic studio portrait of an original adult woman with long hair styled in high twin pigtails with blue gradient tips and two thick braids. Dress her in a frilly white-and-dark-blue maid headdress and an elaborate black-and-white maid outfit with an oversized ruffled collar, puffed sleeves, corset-style bodice, short layered skirt, multiple frills, and bows. Give her fair natural skin with visible pores, soft blush, sparkling expressive eyes, and a slightly shy expression. Center her standing against a pure white seamless background. Use soft diffused front lighting, an 85mm lens at f/4, intricate lace and fabric detail, realistic individual hair strands, high-resolution editorial realism, and no text or watermark.
